name: employed
description: Search live jobs verified on real employer ATS boards, research employers' hiring, and brief hiring markets with Employed by Guaq AI.

interface.longDescription: Employed by Guaq AI is a live job index built from about 5,000 verified employer applicant-tracking boards (Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, Ashby, SmartRecruiters and more). Search roles by domain, seniority, location, work mode, technology and visa signal, open an employer's hiring profile, and turn the data into a short hiring-market brief. Every role links to the employer's own apply page. Visa sponsorship marked likely is an inference from posting text, not a guarantee. Your own Employed account is in the chat too: paste a CV and the assistant fills in your profile, then shows your ranked feed, saves roles to your tracker, records each application's status and follows employers for new-role alerts, only when you ask. It never applies to jobs or contacts anyone. Sign in with your Employed account.
defaultPrompt: Set up my Employed profile from this CV and show my best matches.
Find entry-level backend roles in India.
Is Stripe hiring in London right now?

positive.description: Job search with filters, a count and the visa signal labelled as an inference.
positive.prompt: How many entry-level software engineering roles in the UK likely sponsor a visa? Show me the ten newest.
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the number of matching live roles, then a list of ten with title, employer, city, work mode and the employer's own apply link. Sponsorship is described as likely (an inference from the posting), not confirmed.

positive.description: Employer research, then one posting in full.
positive.prompt: Is Stripe hiring, and for what? Then open the first role in full.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises Stripe's open roles by seniority, function and city, lists a few roles with links, then shows the full posting for the first one with its apply link.

positive.description: Set up the profile from a CV, then show the ranked feed.
positive.prompt: Here is my CV: final-year B.Tech in computer science at IIT Delhi graduating June 2027, Python and React, Indian citizen, open to Bengaluru or remote. Set up my Employed profile and show my best matches.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the profile values it will save (stage, education, graduation date, categories, cities, country and work authorisation) and asks to confirm, saves them in one update, then lists roles from the person's feed ranked by match with apply links. The saved values appear on the Profile tab at jobs.guaqai.me.

positive.description: Track applications: save, update the status, review, remove.
positive.prompt: Save the first role from my feed to my tracker, mark it as applied with the note 'referral from Priya', show my tracker, then remove that role.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the role, records the applied status with the note, lists the tracker showing that role as applied, and after confirmation removes it. Each step is confirmed in the reply.

positive.description: Follow an employer for new-role alerts.
positive.prompt: Follow Wise so I hear when they post new roles, then show which employers I follow.
positive.expected_behavior: Follows Wise and lists the employers the account follows, with Wise included, and whether email alerts are on.

negative.description: Writing help with no job data needed.
negative.prompt: Write a cover letter for a software engineering internship at Google.

negative.description: Salary figures the plugin does not hold.
negative.prompt: What is the average salary of a data scientist in the US?

negative.description: Employer-side hiring, not a job search.
negative.prompt: Post a job opening for a backend engineer at my startup and find candidates.

review.commerce_description: No purchases inside ChatGPT. Plans are sold on jobs.guaqai.me only.

publication.release_notes: Your Employed account in the chat: set up or edit your profile from a CV, read your ranked feed, save roles and track application status, follow employers. Job cards gain a Save button and page in place where the assistant supports it. Plus the hosted search connector (OAuth sign-in) and skills for job search, employer research, hiring-market briefs and application tracking.
